description: This file defines the RedisGrainDirectoryProviderBuilder class, which implements IProviderBuilder for configuring a Redis-based grain directory provider within an Orleans silo. It contains methods to set up Redis connection options based on configuration, supporting both named connection multiplexers and connection strings.

classes.name: RedisGrainDirectoryProviderBuilder
classes.description: A builder class that configures Redis-based grain directory providers for Orleans silos by setting up connection options based on configuration data.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the ISiloBuilder to add Redis grain directory support, setting up connection options via configuration.
